summary: OpenAPI operation route catalogs for messenger, mail, social, and community REST boundary crates.
claim_boundary: Route metadata coverage only. Contract-only routes are deliberately not handlers and do not claim runtime availability, persistence, authorization evaluation, AsyncAPI/proto parity, or deployed endpoint readiness.

facets.F1_simplicity: Each REST crate has a small static OpenAPI route table and lookup function; no router framework, macro generation, or runtime dependency was introduced.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: Honest non-claim: route catalogs improve contract traceability but do not satisfy production/hyperscaler route, telemetry, SLO, or deployment gates.
facets.F3_adversarial: Tests assert exact operation counts and implemented-vs-contract-only status for existing write handlers so future false-green handler claims are visible.
facets.F5_quality: cargo test, clippy -D warnings, and cargo fmt --check pass for the 4 touched REST packages.
facets.F7_security_privacy: No new data handling paths were added; contract-only routes remain metadata and cannot bypass API/usecase policy seams.
facets.F11_observability: The catalog exposes implemented-vs-contract-only state for future route telemetry wiring; no runtime emission claim.

verification.command: cargo test -p oya-messenger-message-stream-rest -p oya-mail-mailbox-store-rest -p oya-social-post-composition-rest -p oya-community-post-store-rest
verification.evidence: 21 unit tests passed across the 4 REST packages.
